label: Maintain — Patch Plan & Rollback
description: Produces a patch plan with explicit rollback for a single device or a fleet. Covers pre-patch verification, OTA / USB reflash sequencing, per-stage acceptance test, post-patch verification, and the rollback chain when the patch fails. Required for any firmware change in a Maintain context.

claudeKnowledge.description: OTA partition layout, signed updates, fleet rollout patterns
